title: Endpoint model core
description: A reproducible two-stage interface: estimate the five-year change from GHSL endpoints, then distribute it over the historical years.
fitting: Unit response of floorspace to horizontal built-surface change. Uniform log timing when no complete activity signal exists. No learned response coefficients.

title: Construction activity timing
description: Keeps the endpoint model and uses qualified construction production indices to time net area additions where available.
equation: Fₜ = F2015 + (F2020 − F2015) × cumulative activity share
fitting: Complete positive activity series distribute positive net additions; net declines and incomplete signals retain uniform log timing. Repairs, completion lags and demolition are unresolved.

title: Shared linear change
description: The preserved default research output. One global ridge response uses surface, population and real GDP per capita changes.
fitting: Country-balanced ridge strength 1; no fitted intercept or country-specific coefficients. The unit surface response is the prior. Native stock changes provide weak labels.

title: Anchor-relative path loss
description: Changes the fitting objective from annual rates to cumulative historical paths relative to the fixed 2020 endpoint.
fitting: Same three drivers and shared ridge structure as v0.3. Its archived seven-country results are shown separately; it has no matched-six result in the latest frozen comparison.

title: Nonlinear residual kernel
description: Allows a shared nonlinear residual around the horizontal-change prior without national correction coefficients.
fitting: Three-driver RBF kernel; fixed length scale 1 and ridge 1. Training-only RMS scales and country-balanced weights. This version number is unrelated to the earlier 0.50 trend-weight candidate.

title: Two-timescale kernel
description: Separates country mean changes from within-country annual deviations, with a timing correction that sums to zero.
equation: rᵧ = xsurface,ᵧ + f(mean x) + g(xᵧ − mean x) − mean g
fitting: Two fixed RBF components with ridge 1 and length 1. Five complete intervals required. The latest common-six protocol does not contain a refitted v0.6 comparator.

title: Development context
description: Adds development-stage information so similar economic changes can have different shared responses in different stock contexts.
equation: rᵧ = xsurface,ᵧ + RBF(dynamic changes, stock context)
fitting: Six predictors: surface/population/real-GDP growth plus real GDP per capita level, urban fraction and built surface per capita. Fixed ridge and kernel length; complete mandatory context required.

title: Annual urban demand & lights
description: Adds derived urban-population changes, constant-price PPP context and source-qualified annual VIIRS radiance.
equation: K = Kbase + Mcontext Kcontext Mcontext + Mlight Klight Mlight
fitting: Masked additive PSD kernels: base three drivers, four context/demand coordinates and one light coordinate. Optional missing branches contribute no fabricated observations. Fixed ridge 1 and RBF length 1.

title: Compact mechanism pooling
description: Uses the expanded source library through four compact shared mechanism coordinates.
equation: rᵧ = horizontal proxyᵧ + Σgroup θgroup mean[tanh(zfactor,ᵧ)]
fitting: Population-demand proxy, UNSD construction activity, real GDP growth and VIIRS lights. Fixed scaling, eligibility rules, group denominators and ridge regularization. Four fitted group coefficients.

title: Expanded mechanism pooling
description: Compresses qualified members of the 43-factor library into six shared groups rather than a high-dimensional kernel.
equation: rᵧ = horizontal proxyᵧ + Σsix groups θgroup mean[tanh(zfactor,ᵧ)]
fitting: Remote, construction, population, economic, stock-risk and nightlight groups. Eligibility is learned from training support under fixed thresholds; unavailable candidates are excluded. Six fitted group coefficients.

title: Cumulative change + signed timing
description: Builds separate shared predictors for five-year net change and the zero-sum annual timing pattern.
equation: C = CGHSL + pooled cumulative correction; rᵧ = C/5 + zero-sum timingᵧ
fitting: Three cumulative coordinates: demand, production and background. Two annual coordinates: activity and demand shock. Training-only scaling, fixed ridge, first-difference smoothing and no annual timing from static features.

title: Quality-conditioned dynamic states
description: Treats qualified GLC annual horizontal changes as a separate partial proxy observation of latent timing.
equation: rᵧ = C/5 + ηᵧ; Σηᵧ = 0; η = conditional smooth-state solve
fitting: Three cumulative plus three annual coefficients. Fixed source/family reliability, partial-observation operators, GLC relative precision 0.50 and smoothness 1. Working covariances are not calibrated GFA uncertainty.

parameters.regularization: one unit Gaussian/ridge penalty per shared dimension; summed independent country losses; not divided by number of countries

title: Flow timing & robust transfer
description: Uses original positive construction/investment/material levels for timing, robust country losses and support-aware attenuation.
equation: C = CGHSL + 0.05 θ · [demand, production, context × supported change]
fitting: Three cumulative and three annual coefficients. Centered log flow levels; fixed Huber δ 1.35, unit ridge and working annual-label covariance. Train-only leverage attenuates residual corrections; it is not a validated Area of Applicability.

title: Stock-capacity timing
description: Retains the v0.12 cumulative estimator and separates activity acceleration from stock-normalized flow intensity.
equation: capacityᵧ = center[log(qualified flowᵧ) − (y − 2020) × GHSL baseline rate]
fitting: Three cumulative and four annual coefficients. An outcome-free training-only projection removes linear capacity/activity redundancy. Fixed robust regularization and zero-sum dynamic states. No new endpoint improvement or adoption.
